steps.say: Welcome, young one. First, food: right-click a berry bush and choose Gather.
steps.hint: Berry bushes are the small green plants near the camp. Walk close, then right-click one.

steps.say: Well done. Now eat: right-click the clan's fire and choose Eat berries.
steps.hint: The clan's fire is in the middle of the camp. Stand near it before you right-click.

steps.say: Good. Last, keep us warm: right-click the fire again and choose Tend the fire.
steps.hint: Same fire, other choice: Tend the fire. It keeps the whole clan warm.

done: You know the first day. The rest is your life: press Esc for your bag, skills and the dominion.
